name: Circular Dish, the Interior with Dragon-and-Phoenix Decor, the Exterior with Dragon-and-Phoenix Roundels, and with Later Interior Border Decoration of Ducks in a Lotus Pond and a Willow Tree
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；Jiajing period, 1522-1566 (porcelain); 19th-early 20th century (enameled decor)；Porcelain with decoration painted in underglaze cobalt blue and with overglaze polychrome enamels added at a later date; with underglaze cobalt blue mark reading "Da Ming Jiajing nian zhi" within a double circle on the base
